Glenview Capital Management Has Decreased Its Apple (AAPL) Position; Last Week Shire plc (SHPG) Analysts 
March 11, 2018 - By Michael Collier 
Glenview Capital Management Llc decreased Apple Inc (AAPL) stake by 1.59% reported in 2017Q3 SEC filing. Glenview Capital Management Llc sold 40,164 shares as Apple Inc (AAPL)’s stock rose 12.78%. The Glenview Capital Management Llc holds 2.49 million shares with $383.69 million value, down from 2.53 million last quarter. Apple Inc now has $913.22 billion valuation. The stock increased 1.72% or $3.04 during the last trading session, reaching $179.98. About 32.19 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48% since March 11, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500.

The stock decreased 0.49% or $0.66 during the last trading session, reaching $133.46. About 466,675 shares traded. Shire plc (NASDAQ:SHPG) has risen 4.69% since March 11, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 12.01% the S&P500. 
Shire plc, a biotechnology company, focused on serving people with rare diseases and other specialized conditions worldwide. The company has market cap of $40.20 billion. The firm offers products in therapeutic areas, including hematology, genetic diseases, neuroscience, immunology, internal medicine, ophthalmology, and oncology. It has a 9.51 P/E ratio. The Company’s marketed products include ADVATE and ADYNOVATE/ADYNOVI for hemophilia A; RIXUBIS to treat hemophilia B; VONVENDI for the treatment of von willebrand Disease; FEIBA to treat hemophilia A and B patients with inhibitors; CINRYZE and FIRAZYR for hereditary angioedema; ELAPRASE to treat hunter syndrome; REPLAGAL for Fabry disease; and VPRIV to treat type 1 Gaucher disease. 
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on May, 1. They expect $2.72 earnings per share, up 29.52% or $0.62 from last year’s $2.1 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $13.80B for 16.54 P/E if the $2.72 EPS becomes a reality. After $3.89 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -30.08% negative EPS growth. 
Glenview Capital Management Llc increased Kindred Healthcare Inc (NYSE:KND) stake by 1.84M shares to 4.22 million valued at $28.68M in 2017Q3. It also upped Cbs Corp New (NYSE:CBS) stake by 727,547 shares and now owns 6.57 million shares. Endo Intl Plc (NASDAQ:ENDP) was raised too.
